usage_caveat: Contains authoring, reviews, pilots, regeneration, input QC and response judging; provider pricing/billing may differ. Requests are ledger entries, not unique case costs.
limitations: Synthetic clean speech, four instructed adult voices; no real-room noise or far-field generalization claim.
Fixed purposeful user nodes, no hidden rescue turns. Groups share cumulative prefixes; development and test have separate IDs/families but share scenario templates.
Same-model authoring review is not independent human review.
One seed, one model audio judge; confidence intervals cover scene sampling, not all model/judge uncertainty.
Reference-compatible backbones differ in precision and runtime from native Edge; results compare complete deployed systems.
Offline ASR/TTS caching and batching mean interaction timings are not end-to-end real-time latency.

revision.source_machine_audit: DeepSeek official API; independent human calibration not performed

semantic_consistency_review.scope: uniform review of every audible primary decision using its actual heard transcript, user requirements and tool evidence; not a second independent audio listening
semantic_consistency_review.final_policy: When primary and review disagree or numeric evidence needs review: one blinded fresh audio adjudication. Objective failures remain failures; first schema-valid result, no best-score selection.
